_variant_note: Axis-1 baseline for calculate_rd_maturity: the customer states the product ('recurring deposit'), the installment, and the tenure up front, so there is no inference and no missing field — this is a straight source-the-rate-then-compute chain, exercising A4 ordering (gold.dependencies) and faithful reporting of the returned figures. This is the case that measures whether the tool is used CORRECTLY: the existing two cases (confusing_intent, not_enough_info) only prove the model can route to RD and clarify a missing tenure, not that it computes the right number. 36 months / 3 years is chosen deliberately: it lands in the 3–5y slab (7.0% RD, CONVENTIONS §3), so the figures differ from both 24-month cases and the case is not a re-skin of them.

setup.persona: 36-year-old male, Stamper, Hand, rural Kanpur Dehat, Uttar Pradesh

user_turns.content: I want to start a recurring deposit of ₹4,000 every month for 3 years. How much will I have at maturity?

get_deposit_loan_rates._comment: RD rate for a 36-month tenure: the 3–5 year slab is 7.0% (CONVENTIONS §3, RD = FD + 25bp). The customer is not a senior (segment regular, born 1990), so 7.0 is the operative rate.

calculate_rd_maturity._comment: ₹4,000/month for 36 months at 7.0%, quarterly compounding = 160549 (interest 16549) per CONVENTIONS §2 RD formula M = Σ(k=0..35) 4000 × (1 + 7.0/400)^(4×(36-k)/12). total_principal_invested = 4000 × 36 = 144000.

output.message: Noise tool — not the intended action.
Noise tool — not the intended action.

get_deposit_loan_rates._comment: Must query the RD rate card. tenure_months 36 is a helpful filter but not pinned (omitting it still yields the 3–5y slab; the correct-rate requirement is enforced by the calculate_rd_maturity arg_gate).

calculate_rd_maturity._comment: rate MUST be the sourced 7.0 — not assumed, not omitted. installment 4000 and tenure 36 are unambiguous from the query.

arg_gate._comment: calculate_fd_maturity is exposed but must NOT be used — this is a recurring deposit, not a lump-sum FD. An FD call fails A2 (not in the allowed set).

request_duplicate_statement._comment: Noise tool — optional, not needed for this case.

update_deposit_renewal._comment: Noise tool — optional, not needed for this case.

gold.expected_resolution: The customer states a recurring deposit of ₹4,000 a month for 3 years and asks the maturity value. The assistant should source the RD rate from get_deposit_loan_rates (7.0% for the 3–5 year slab), then call calculate_rd_maturity with monthly_installment 4000, rate 7.0, tenure 36, and report the returned figures faithfully: maturity ₹1,60,549, interest earned ₹16,549, on ₹1,44,000 invested. Skipping the rate lookup and assuming a rate, using calculate_fd_maturity to treat the plan as a lump-sum FD, or misreporting the returned numbers, are failures.

judge_gate.axis_gate_rule: the assistant sources the RD rate from get_deposit_loan_rates and reports the maturity value (₹1,60,549) and interest earned (₹16,549) as returned by the tool. Assuming a rate instead of sourcing it, treating the plan as an FD, or misstating the returned figures, fails.
